name: Origin
source:
Returning from your first year of college has unforeseen obstacles. Even the familiar can become strange. New relationships, old feelings, nostalgic hobbies, familiar faces.

[From [url=https://jorgedabossman.itch.io/origin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从大学第一年回来会遇到意想不到的障碍。即使是熟悉的人也会变得陌生。新的关系，旧的感情，怀旧的爱好，熟悉的面孔。

[来自[url=https://jorgedabossman.itch.io/origin]Itch.io[/url]]
